units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps. A medium shot at eye level, camera locked off with a barely perceptible drift. A young Taipei woman of 2000 waits leaning against a tiled shopfront wall, one canvas bag on her shoulder; she breathes quietly, a strand of hair moves in the warm night air, the sodium lamps behind her flicker once. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks, halation on practical lights. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject only.

Single continuous take at 24fps. A medium two-shot at eye level, the camera holds still. A young couple sit side by side on a grassy hill at night under a clear starfield, she leans slightly toward him; both breathe slowly, a little breeze stirs the grass at the frame bottom, the stars stay fixed. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, milky lifted blacks, visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject only.
